scope: Local CUA window-capture behavior with a generated non-sensitive AppKit control; not product player pixels or a product fix.
observation: The same drawn blue test window produces blank white CUA captures under none, readable blue content under readOnly, and blank white again under none. Foreground state remains fixed; only the test window sharing mode and button caption change.
initialControlLimit: Initial none/readOnly captures differed in focus/DPR. Successor adds raised same-window none/readOnly/none control; original sources/shots retained outsideGit.
curationCorrection: Initial scratch bank incorrectly required over99percent-white despite capture-tool cursor halos. The diagnostic metrics are descriptive, not a product acceptance threshold; report actual values and observed content instead. No product rerun or requirement changed.
meaning: Blank protected-window captures cannot establish blank real pixels. Production PreviewWindow uses sharingType.none, so current external screenshots cannot settle visible player acceptance. Saved movie/Apple playback readiness are separately proven.
